note: Bighorn NF campground on the southeast shore of West Tensleep Lake, at the end of FR 27 (about 7 miles of gravel north of US 16 on the Cloud Peak Skyway); the West Tensleep trailhead into the Cloud Peak Wilderness is just north. The lake is non-motorized only. The concessionaire says larger RVs and trailers can't be accommodated and points them to Boulder Park. After the season it stays open to self-supported camping while weather permits, with no water, trash or cleaning. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page read: 10 reservable sites (9 RV 30-45 ft, site 9 tent), $18.50+tax (FS says $20), $9 extra vehicle, 14-day, vault toilets + water, dump 17 mi away (all manual). Lakeview holds (canopy, sites 30-40 m through trees). PIN MOVE ~470 m (stored pin is the trailhead lot). Phone empty -> 307-431-7446. 'Larger RVs not accommodated' wording flagged (sites fit a 23-ft rig).
flags: PIN MOVE ~470 m: stored 44.2622,-107.2129 is the West Tensleep trailhead parking lot; campground loop/site centroid 44.2585,-107.2158 (FS point 44.25861524,-107.2157863).
WATERFRONT: lakeview holds. Nearest sites 002 (~44.25883,-107.21597), 003 and 004 are ~30-40 m from the shore through continuous conifer canopy - a view value, not lakefront.

ACCESS WORDING (reviewer's call, not a drop as read): recreation.gov notice 'Larger RVs and trailers cannot be accommodated; Boulder Park Campground is recommended for larger units' - but the catalog's per-site limits are 30-45 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits every RV site. The note's old 'RVs to 45 ft can navigate' (unsourced) was removed.
